address: Archangelkade 3D, Amsterdam-West (Houthavens / Haparandaweg industrial strip): 1978 barrel-roofed warehouse hall, 75 m by 60 m, clad in pale vertical-ribbed sheet steel with a curved eaves line and downpipes at the bays
notes: Archangelkade 3D (BAG pand 0363100012099348, built 1978, 124 3DBAG wall surfaces, roof max 11.9 m): a barrel-roofed warehouse hall on the industrial strip between the Archangelkade and the Haparandaweg, about 75 m by 60 m. One panorama within 35 m shows it: the 75 m north-west flank (w01-323), a plain wall of pale vertical-ribbed sheet steel under a curved eaves line with two downpipes; w02-233 has no panorama.

walls[0] = panel 0 (NW, 75 m, eaves 8.8; surface 1): drawn as a blank two-storey wall with 24 vertical piers standing in for the sheet-steel ribs, in pale render. Simplified: the true ribs are 20 cm apart, the piers are one per 3 m bay; the curved eaves line is the 3DBAG roof. Not drawn: the downpipes (too small), the doors on the unphotographed sides; the other three walls stay blank pale render.
